handover.title: Shift handover
handover.subtitle: The report is built from what the shift recorded. Approval by whoever hands over and acknowledgement by whoever takes over stay on the audit trail.
handover.progressHint: Acceptance is patient by patient, and the system measures how long each one took.
handover.empty: No handover reports yet. Close a shift on the schedule to generate them.
handover.countersHint: Overdue tasks are already counted among the pending ones.
handover.noNarrative: This report has no written summary yet. The counts above already stand on their own.
handover.unreviewed: not reviewed by the outgoing clinician
handover.unreviewedHint: The report stays fully visible: nothing is hidden or blocked for lack of approval. The omission is recorded on the audit trail.
handover.ackHint: Acknowledgement records who took over and how long it took since this screen opened.
handover.schedule.title: Shift schedule
handover.schedule.subtitle: When a shift ends without an approved report, the gap shows up here.
handover.schedule.name: Shift name
handover.schedule.vetResponsibleHint: Tick for the licensed professional answering for this shift.
handover.schedule.empty: No shifts on the schedule yet.
handover.schedule.noVetHint: No licensed professional answers for this shift.
handover.schedule.onDutyEmpty: Nobody on duty at this hour.
handover.schedule.missingReview: Shift closed: {{n}} reports were left without review.
handover.schedule.noMissingReview: Shift closed with every report reviewed.
handover.schedule.gapHint: Schedule a licensed professional before the shift starts.
handover.schedule.noGaps: Every shift on the schedule has a responsible vet.
handover.schedule.evidence: The rota is the proof that the clinic had a responsible veterinarian on every shift, with name and licence. It is what the inspection asks for.
handover.schedule.membershipsBlocked: Only the administrator sees the team list. Names show up as identifiers.
handover.emptyHint: Close the shift in the shift console to generate one bulletin per inpatient.
handover.reportsHint: Accept one at a time, looking at what stays open.
handover.openTasksNone: No pending task in the next 12 hours.
handover.openTasksHint: These pendings pass to whoever takes over now.
handover.ackHintCard: Accepting records who received it and how long it took since this bulletin came into view.
handover.doneHint: Every bulletin in this shift was accepted. The shift is yours.
handover.contextUnavailable: Schedule and team did not load ({{message}}): shifts appear without names. The bulletins below are still valid.
handover.receiveSubtitle: {{from}} handed over the {{shift}}. Accept patient by patient, looking at what stays with you.
handover.deliverSubtitle: To {{to}} · {{shift}}. Review each patient's summary and approve.
handover.receiveHint: What stays with you is written on each card.
handover.deliverHint: You can write the summary yourself, or ask for a draft and edit it.
handover.receivedHint: All accepted. From here the patients are yours.
handover.deliveredHint: Every bulletin approved. You can close the shift.
handover.notYours: No handover of yours right now
handover.notYoursHint: The handover appears when a shift of yours is starting or ending. The rota is built in management.
handover.writePlaceholder: Write how this patient's shift went, or ask for a draft and edit it.
handover.awaitingAck: Waiting for the receiver to accept
handover.nothingOpenHint: The shift left no pending item for this patient.
